## Core engine

### Parsing

- [ ] **Bold task** (ref 1.2) -- body with a [link](docs/x.md#part) and [web](https://example.com) and [anchor](#here).
- [ ] Plain task -- the rest after a dash.
- [ ] Plain sentence task. More words after it.
- **An epic** -- with children:
  - [ ] **Child one** -- first child.
  - [ ] **Child two.** Second child, title ends in a period.
  - A note about the epic, with **bold** inside.
  - **Bold note**: no checkbox, no children.
  - **Nested epic**: no checkbox, but it has a child.
    - [ ] **Grandchild** -- its parent is the nested epic.

### Layout

- [ ] **Task with children**
  - [ ] **Its child** -- tasks can be parents too.
